name: Something Stirs…
text: *This agenda gets +1[per_investigator] doom threshold. Forced - When this agenda advances: Do not remove doom from each location in play.
back_text: Spawn the set-aside Harbinger of Valusia at the location with the most doom.
flavor: Despite Ichtaca's warnings, you've entered the ruins of the temple in search of ancient knowledge and artifacts.
back_flavor: Just then, a sound thrums in the walls of the temple, a dull humming similar to that of a generator. Grooves in the walls and the ceiling flicker and start to glow. It is as though the temple is alive, and it senses your presence. The strange statues and carvings you've seen, coupled with the dim glow and the power coursing through the walls, makes it clear that this temple isn't Aztec in origin. In fact, it appears to be from an even older, more ancient civilization altogether. You feel as though you are an intruder in a world you cannot begin to understand. Confirming your worst fears, a loud hiss and rattling echoes throughout the temple. Whatever you just woke up, it's not happy to see you.
real_text: *This agenda gets +1 [per_investigator] doom threshold. Forced - When this agenda advances: Do not remove doom from each location in play.

name: The Temple Warden
text: *This agenda gets +1[per_investigator] doom threshold.
back_text: Each investigator who has not resigned is defeated.
flavor: The serpent creature emerges from the shadows with terrifying speed. It is bedecked in ornate gold feathers, and it wields a golden spear, the blade tip unravaged by time. The rattle at the end of the creature's tail produces a tremendous noise as the creature hunts you throughout the ruins.
back_flavor: The ruins groan and shake with anger. You are not wanted here. The walls and ceiling shift erratically, blocking off corridors and attempting to prevent your escape. Grooves in the stone are now glowing a vibrant red hue. A sinister hiss follows you throughout the temple. The realization dawns on you that you are not making it out of this place alive…
real_text: *This agenda gets +1 [per_investigator] doom threshold.

name: Into the Ruins
text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.
back_text:
Shuffle the set-aside Chamber of Time location into the exploration deck.
As you pass the strange glyphs in the walls, the ruins groan and creak in protest, and the carvings glow ominously. Years of deterioration have faded the pattern of these glyphs, and the surrounding stones seep with a venomous pus. If only you had some way to restore these glyphs…
Check your supplies. If any investigator has chalk, remove this act from the game. Otherwise, place this act in the victory display. It gains Vengeance 1.
flavor: After your hellish journey through the jungle, the quiet solitude of the temple ruins sows paranoia in your mind. Serpent eyes glare at you from the darkness. Every drop of water and fallen pebble causes you to whirl about in search of danger… But the real danger is yet to come.
back_flavor: The ruins are far more vast than even Alejandro had anticipated. Carvings in the walls and hieroglyphs etched into stone altars suggest the existence of a central chamber underground. Perhaps a hidden passageway will show you the way to this chamber - the very heart of the temple ruins.
real_text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.

name: Magic and Science
text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it. Objective - Only investigators in the Chamber of Time may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
back_text: Choose an investigator in the Chamber of Time to take control of the Relic of Ages. Move the placement of each location to form a straight line, with the Chamber of Time on the left and the Entryway on the right. Each other location is placed from left to right in between these two locations, in order of how much doom is on them, from lowest to highest (in the event of a tie, you may decide the order). Until the end of the scenario, ignore all location connections. Instead, each location is connected to each location to its left and right.
flavor: Whatever is inside this central chamber must be very important; much care was taken to obscure its location.
back_flavor: The relic hums with power and throbs in your hands. Energy from the device seeps into the corridors of the ruins, and the structure of the temple shifts.
real_text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it. Objective - Only investigators in the Chamber of Time may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

name: Escape the Ruins
text: While there are 3 or more vengeance points in the victory display, each [[Serpent]] enemy gets +1 evade. Objective - If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.
back_text:
If an investigator resigned with the Relic of Ages under his or her control:
The floor of the temple stops shaking, and the dull humming in the walls goes quiet. Without the relic in its chamber, the ruins appear to be sleeping once more. You still have no idea what the object is or what its purpose may be, but you dare not tarry any longer to find out.
(→R1) Otherwise:
For a moment, the temple continues to shudder, the architecture twisting and contorting strangely. Pleased that it is once again whole, the temple then returns to its dormant state.
(→R3)
flavor: The ruins are shuddering with a tremendous power. You fear that the structure may collapse if this keeps up. You have to escape with the relic!
back_flavor: As soon as you cross the threshold of the entryway, something inside the temple begins to change…
real_text: While there are 3 or more vengeance points in the victory display, each [[Serpent]] enemy gets +1 evade. Objective - If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.

name: Entryway
text: [action]: Resign. You've escaped… for now. [action]: Check your supplies. If you have torches, look at the top 2 cards of the exploration deck. Discard each treachery looked at by this effect. Shuffle the exploration deck.
flavor: Many hundreds of years ago, this temple might have been a bastion of beauty and reverence in this perilous jungle.
back_flavor: The sun sets over the temple ruins, bathing the stone in warm light. The sounds of the rainforest are distant by the time you cross underneath the painted entryway. Inside, the halls are plunged into darkness.
real_text: [action]: Resign. You've escaped… for now. [action]: Check your supplies. If you have torches, look at the top 2 cards of the exploration deck. Discard each treachery looked at by this effect. Shuffle the exploration deck.

name: Silas Marsh
text:
[reaction] Dopo che hai rivelato 1 segnalino caos durante una prova di abilità che stai effettuando: Rimetti 1 abilità che hai investito in questa prova nella tua mano. (Limite di una volta per round.)

back_text: Dimensione del Mazzo: 30 carte. Opzioni del Mazzo: Carte Sopravvissuto ([survivor]) di livello 0-5, carte neutrali di livello 0-5, abilità [[Innato]] di livello 0-2. Requisiti del Mazzo (non considerati nella dimensione del mazzo): Arpione della Controcorrente, Rete di Silas, Richiamo della Sirena, 1 debolezza base casuale.
flavor: "Lasciate le vostre paure al molo."
back_flavor: Silas Marsh si è sempre sentito chiamato dal mare. Da ragazzo, lasciò la sua famiglia nell'ombrosa Innsmouth e divenne noto tra i marinai dei sette mari. Ma dopo la morte dei suoi genitori, il richiamo del mare crebbe solo di intensità. Silas fa sogni - incubi - di denti acuminati, mani palmate, e occhi che brillano nelle oscure profondità oceaniche. Nessun membro della sua famiglia è in grado di spiegargli l'origine di questi sogni, o per lo meno non vuole. E così, quando la disperata bibliotecaria Abigail Foreman rivolge le sue domande a Silas, lui non riesce a rifiutarla. Il suo antico tomo, il <u>Prophesiae Profana</u>, indica che un evento astronomico annuncerà la fine del mondo, e dipinti sui margini delle sue pagine si trovano le stesse creature che popolano gli incubi di Silas...

University students travel from class to class, businesspeople take breaks from their busy office lives, and in Easttown, Velma's Diner is abuzz with the lunch rush. flavor: This conspiracy runs much deeper than you had imagined. The more time you spend investigating these mysteries, the more you come to realize they are linked to one another. At the center of these secrets is an enigmatic organization, manipulating events behind the scenes...
back_flavor: The streets begin to empty as evening approaches. When the office buildings shut their doors, the clubs open theirs, in places both public and hidden from view. In downtown Arkham, the Ward Theatre is well lit and filled to capacity. The surrounding streets, however, are eerily quiet. Only soft footsteps from nearby alleyways hint at any sign of life, and a cold wind whistles through the air. The workday might have ended, but your work is far from over. The figures walking down the street start to fill you with a sense of dread instead of comfort.
real_text: [action]: Resign. You don't want to risk taking too long, so you head to safety with the information you've gathered.

flavor: Who can you trust in this city of lies? Arkham may be safe from the perils of the jungle, but you are far from safe here. Each passing stranger in the dark of night could be a kidnapper, a thief, or a killer. Each glance they send your way could be the last thing you ever see.
back_flavor: Midnight arrives, but your work is not done. You wander the streets of Arkham for hours, frustrated as the trails you have pursued grow cold over time. When the sun rises, fatigue has wreaked havoc on your body and mind.

flavor: One of the museum security guards, a man named Drew Walker, recognizes you from your prior work with Alejandro and Dr. Horowitz. "Look, I ain’t supposed to be letting anybody into the exhibit... But the coppers don’t know from nothing when it comes to this hokum." He steps aside and lets you pass. "If anybody asks, you slipped in while I was using the john, all right? Don’t take any wooden nickels."
back_flavor: You search the exhibit where the relic was to be on display, looking for signs of where it may have been taken. Though you find no concrete evidence, on the ground near the exhibit entrance, you do notice several recent scuff marks made by men's shoes. You ask Drew who was last to see the exhibit after Alejandro left. "Some suits. Government types," he replies. "They had clearing to see the exhibit from Mr. Walsted, the curator." It's far from proof of the relic's location, but it's a lead - hopefully one that will point you in the right direction.

back_flavor: Henry looks about anxiously, then leans forward and speaks in a hushed tone. "All right, listen. I work downtown, as assistant to the city planner. He's a bit of a funny bird. He gets up and puts on his coat, leaving two quarters on the table. "You didn't hear this from me," he insists before departing.

name: La Mente Criminale
text: Ogni luogo [[Distorsione]] ottiene: "[action] [survivor]4+1< T %2[cultist]+: <+@2 H <@6@~+ [willpower]9 EIXODOLON. (Limite di una volta in totale per partita.)" Obiettivo - Se ogni investigatore è sconfitto, proseguite con la trama.
back_text: In questa linea temporale, il rituale è completo. Se state giocando in modalità multiplayer epico, spostate tutti i danni da Eixodolon alla copia di Eixodolon di un altro gruppo. Ogni investigatore di questo gruppo è ucciso. (→R1)
flavor: Vi affrettate a raggiungere la camera successiva nella speranza di trovare un'uscita da questo incubo, ma il cancello d'acciaio che vi sbarra la strada sopprime quella speranza. Le pareti sono ricoperte di enigmatiche incisioni e un simbolo sul pavimento sembra pulsare di potere. Proprio allora, una figura emerge dalle ombre.
back_flavor: La voce distorta della mente criminale sembra prorompere in una sorta di risata stridente. "Il vostro dolore è potente" spiega la voce. "Essere strappati da un luogo sicuro, trascinati nel pericolo e conservare la speranza... per poi vedersi sottratta e soppressa anche quella." Le rune sul pavimento del magazzino abbandonato risplendono di una luce più intensa e dalle crepe del cemento trasudano rivoli di sangue che iniziano a scorrere lungo le pareti. "Lo so che non è giusto", ammette la voce, "ma niente lo è mai."
real_text: Each [[Distortion]] location gains: "[action] [survivor]4+1< T %2[cultist]+: <+@2 H <@6@~+ [willpower]9 EIXODOLON. (Group limit once per game.)" Objective - If each investigator is defeated, advance this agenda.

name: Distorsioni Temporali (Gruppo A)
text: Timer - Non proseguite con i capitoli finché non ricevete l'istruzione di farlo. Quando proseguite con la trama, devono esserci 11 o più destini in gioco (se proseguite con la trama e non soddisfate questa condizione, ogni investigatore di questo gruppo sarà ucciso).
back_text:
Se c'erano 11 o più destini in gioco quando avete proseguito con la trama:
Girate la manopola del congegno portandola al valore massimo, sforzandovi di stringere la presa su di essa mentre i vostri muscoli si irrigidiscono e iniziate a decomporvi. La manopola si ferma con uno scatto, poi riuscite a continuare a girarla nella stessa direzione. Scatto dopo scatto siete scossi da un dolore lancinante, finché la manopola non torna nel punto dove si trovava inizialmente. L'aria si fa meno pesante e il tempo torna a scorrere al suo ritmo originale.
Risolvete la Preparazione del Capitolo 3.
b>Se c'erano 10 o meno destini in gioco quando avete proseguito con la trama:
La vostra pelle e i vostri muscoli si tendono e vi sentite rapidamente prosciugati della vostra energia vitale. Cercate di urlare, ma dalla vostra gola non esce aria. I vostri organi avvizziscono e si decompongono. "La sorte inevitabile che ci attende tutti" spiega una voce sinistra. Nel giro di pochi minuti, non siete altro che un cumulo di polvere.
Ogni investigatore di questo gruppo è ucciso. (→R1)
flavor: Sul vostro biglietto continuano ad apparire altre parole: "Il tempo scorre in modo diverso nella prossima camera" recita. "Se non agite in fretta, vi decomporrete in un mucchietto di polvere."
real_text: Timed - Do not advance this act until you are instructed. When the agenda advances, there must be at least 11 doom in play. (Beware - If the agenda advances and you do not meet this condition, each investigator in this group will be killed.)

I pavimenti e le pareti dell'intero labirinto iniziano a muoversi e a ruotare tutt'intorno a voi. Il terreno vi scivola via da sotto i piedi e la gravità si distorce, scagliandovi nella fossa venefica.

text: Timer - Non proseguite con i capitoli finché non ricevete l'istruzione di farlo. Prima di proseguire con la trama, trovate un modo per affrontare il Famiglio di Eixodolon (se il famiglio è ancora "rinchiuso" quando proseguite con la trama, si libererà da solo).
back_text:
Se avete "inviato il Famiglio di Eixodolon a un altro gruppo": Scegliete un altro gruppo casuale. Alla fine del round attuale, quel gruppo genera la sua copia del Famiglio di Eixodolon messa da parte in un suo Corridoio Labirintico. Risolvete la Preparazione del Capitolo 3.
Se il Famiglio di Eixodolon si trova nella galleria delle vittorie:
Tirate un sospiro di sollievo quando la creatura crolla a terra senza vita.
Risolvete la Preparazione del Capitolo 3.
Se nessuna delle due condizioni si è verificata:
Spinta dalla fame, la creatura sfonda il vetro del suo terrario e si avventa su chiunque le capiti a tiro.
Muovete il Famiglio di Eixodolon nella Camera della Fame. Questi attacca ogni investigatore nella Camera della Fame, in ordine di gioco. Risolvete la Preparazione del Capitolo 3.
flavor: Sul vostro biglietto continuano a comparire nuove parole luminose: "Nella camera davanti a voi vive il mio adorato famiglio" recita la scritta. "Ha molta fame: forse dovreste aprire la porta e permettergli di sfamarsi."
real_text: Timed - Do not advance this act until you are instructed. Find a way to deal with Eixodolon's Pet before the agenda advances. (Beware - If the creature is still "locked away" when the agenda advances, it will break free.)

name: La Fuga
text: Obiettivo - Alla fine del round, se Eixodolon ha 0 Salute rimanente, potete spostare un qualsiasi numero di suoi danni in eccesso sulla copia di Eixodolon di un altro gruppo. Poi proseguite con i capitoli.
back_text:
Se una copia di Eixodolon nell'area di gioco di un gruppo sopravvissuto ha 1 o più Salute rimanente:
La figura si deforma e inizia a scivolare attraverso lo spazio-tempo.
Girate questa carta capitolo.
Se ogni copia di Eixodolon nell'area di gioco dei gruppi sopravvissuti ha 0 Salute rimanente: - Se soltanto un gruppo è sopravvissuto, (→R2). - Se soltanto due gruppi sono sopravvissuti, (→R3). - Se tutti e tre i gruppi sono sopravvissuti, (→R4).
flavor: "Siete vicini alla libertà" annuncia la voce distorta e crepitante della figura. "C'è ancora speranza nelle vostre parole? C'è ancora luce nei vostri occhi?"
real_text: Objective - At the end of the round, if Eixodolon has no remaining health, you may move any damage on him in excess of his health to another group's copy of Eixodolon. Then, advance.

name: La Fuga
text: Obiettivo - Se Eixodolon ha 0 Salute rimanente, proseguite con i capitoli.
back_text:
Se state giocando in modalità autoconclusiva: (→R2).
Se state giocando una mini-campagna e questo è il primo o il secondo gruppo: Iniziate con un nuovo gruppo per scoprire quale risoluzione raggiungere.
Se state giocando una mini-campagna e questo è il terzo gruppo: - Se soltanto un gruppo è sopravvissuto, (→R2). - Se soltanto due gruppi sono sopravvissuti, (→R3). - Se tutti e tre i gruppi sono sopravvissuti,s (→R4).
flavor: "Siete vicini alla libertà" annuncia la voce distorta e crepitante della figura. "C'è ancora speranza nelle vostre parole? C'è ancora luce nei vostri occhi?"
real_text: Objective - If Eixodolon has no remaining health, advance.

name: Camera dei Segreti
text: [action]: Colpisci con i pugni la parete della camera. Non ottieni alcuna risposta.
flavor: Sulla parete è scarabocchiata una rozza scritta che recita "DESTRA". Forse è un indizio ... ma cosa significa?
back_flavor: Questa camera è sigillata. Non c'è alcuna porta che conduce all'esterno: soltanto un buco della serratura dalla strana forma situato su un muro della camera. Le pareti e il soffitto della stanza sono ricoperti da uno strato di tubature di rame arrugginite che circondano gli ospiti da ogni lato.
real_text: [action]: You pound your fists on the wall of the chamber. Nobody responds.

name: Camera dei Segreti
text: [action]: Colpisci con i pugni la parete della camera. Non ottieni alcuna risposta.
flavor: Sulla parete è scarabocchiata una rozza scritta che recita "CENTRO". Forse è un indizio ... ma cosa significa?
back_flavor: Questa camera è sigillata. Non c'è alcuna porta che conduce all'esterno: soltanto un buco della serratura dalla strana forma situato su un muro della camera. Le pareti e il soffitto della stanza sono ricoperti da uno strato di tubature di rame arrugginite che circondano gli ospiti da ogni lato.
real_text: [action]: You pound your fists on the wall of the chamber. Nobody responds.

flavor: Sulla parete è scarabocchiata una rozza scritta che recita "SINISTRA". Forse è un indizio ... ma cosa significa?
back_flavor: Questa camera è sigillata. Non c'è alcuna porta che conduce all'esterno: soltanto un buco della serratura dalla strana forma situato su un muro della camera. Le pareti e il soffitto della stanza sono ricoperti da uno strato di tubature di rame arrugginite che circondano gli ospiti da ogni lato.
real_text: [action]: You pound your fists on the wall of the chamber. Nobody responds.

name: Camera della Pioggia
text: La Camera della Pioggia è sigillata e l'acqua continua a scorrere. Finché sei al Capitolo 1, questo luogo ottiene: "Gli investigatori non possono entrare in questo luogo o lasciarlo. Obbligo - Quando un investigatore in questo luogo pesca una carta nemico: Scartala e pesca una nuova carta per sostituirla."
back_flavor: Dalle pareti della camera cade un getto d'acqua che riempie gradualmente la cisterna. Con orrore, non sembra accennare a fermarsi.
real_text: The Chamber of Rain is sealed shut while the water flows. While it is Act 1, this location gains: "Investigators cannot move into or out of this location. Forced - When an investigator here draws an enemy card: Discard it and draw a new card to replace it."

name: Camera del Dolore
text: [action]: Effettua una prova di [combat] (1) per sfondare la porta del terrario allagato. Sia in caso di successo che di fallimento, la porta non cede. Annota che hai "fatto il possibile".
back_flavor: Questa camera contiene varie cisterne di metallo dalle finestre in vetro: molte sono piene d'acqua e al loro interno si intravedono i cadaveri di vari animali che devono essere annegati lentamente e dolorosamente. Che genere di individuo osserverebbe mai una scena come questa?
real_text: [action]: Test [combat] (1) to try to break down the door to the flooding terrarium. Regardless of whether you succeed or fail, it does not budge. Remember that you "tried your best."

name: Camera del Dolore
text: [action]: Effettua una prova di [willpower] (2) per interpretare il diagramma tracciato sul vetro. Se hai successo, prendi il controllo di 1 indizio posseduto da un investigatore nella Camera del Dolore o nella Camera della Pioggia (o su quel luogo, se sei l'unico investigatore della partita). Qualsiasi investigatore nella Camera del Dolore o nella Camera della Pioggia può effettuare questa azione.
back_flavor: Questa camera contiene varie cisterne di metallo dalle finestre in vetro: molte sono piene d'acqua e al loro interno si intravedono i cadaveri di vari animali che devono essere annegati lentamente e dolorosamente. Che genere di individuo osserverebbe mai una scena come questa?
real_text: [action]: Test [willpower] (2) to interpret the diagram inscribed on the glass. If you succeed, take control of 1 clue on an investigator in either Chamber of Sorrows or Chamber of Rain (or from that location if you are the only investigator in the game). Any investigator in either Chamber of Sorrows or Chamber of Rain may perform this action.

name: Camera della Notte
text: [action]: Chiedi aiuto con tutto il fiato che hai in gola. Non ottieni alcuna risposta.
flavor: Le mensole di legno di questa camera buia sono talmente marcite che sembra strano riescano a sorreggere qualcosa senza crollare.
back_flavor: L'unica luce in questa camera di stoccaggio proviene da alcune candele disseminate per la stanza. Nella penombra si intravedono solo casse, bottiglie e scatole da ogni lato.
real_text: [action]: You call out for help as loud as you can. Nobody responds.

name: Camera della Notte
text: [action]: Effettua una prova di [intellect] (4). Se hai successo, noti una strana scritta tracciata sul muro; guarda il lato aperto del luogo sotto la carta di consultazione dello scenario. Quando sei soddisfatto, ricollocala sotto la carta di consultazione dello scenario.
back_flavor: L'unica luce in questa camera di stoccaggio proviene da alcune candele disseminate per la stanza. Nella penombra si intravedono solo casse, bottiglie e scatole da ogni lato.
real_text: [action]: Test [intellect] (4). If you succeed, you notice strange writing inscribed along the wall; look at the revealed side of the location underneath the scenario reference card. When you are satisfied, place it back underneath the scenario reference card.

name: Camera del Rimpianto
text:
Soltanto un investigatore alla volta può trovarsi nella Camera del Rimpianto.
[action] Gli investigatori spendono un totale di 2 [per_investigator] indizi: Scegli una delle tre leve (sinistra, centro o destra) da tirare. Non appena lo fai, la grata si chiude con un tonfo alle tue spalle. Non puoi lasciare la Camera del Rimpianto per il resto del capitolo attuale.
back_text: Soltanto un investigatore alla volta può trovarsi nella Camera del Rimpianto.
back_flavor: Nel muro di pietra è stato ricavato uno stanzino simile a un ripostiglio con tre leve prive di segni distintivi. Una grata di ferro sollevata minaccia di sigillare la camera non appena sarà messo un piede al suo interno.
real_text:
No more than one investigator may be in the Chamber of Regret at a time.
[action] The investigators spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: You pull one of the 3 levers (choose one): left, middle, or right. As soon as you do, the gate slams shut behind you. You cannot leave the Chamber of Regret for the remainder of the current act.

name: Corridoio Labirintico
text: [fast] Scegli e scarta 2 carte dalla tua mano: Trovi 2 una vecchia cassetta di sicurezza e decidi di lasciare qualcosa indietro. Alla fine del round, scegli un altro investigatore di un qualsiasi gruppo. Quell'investigatore pesca 2 carte. (Limite di una volta in totale per partita.)
flavor: Un orrendo fetore si fa sempre più forte all'addentrarsi in questi corridoi.
back_flavor: Questo strano complesso industriale è composto da lunghi corridoi di acciaio corrugato e di cemento. Le molte porte chiuse a chiave e i vicoli ciechi fanno temere che non sarà facile trovare la via d'uscita.
real_text: [fast] Choose and discard 2 cards from your hand: You find an old lockbox in a pile of refuse, and decide to leave something behind. At the end of the round, choose another investigator in any group. That investigator draws 2 cards. (Group limit once per game.)

name: Corridoio Labirintico
text: [fast] Spendi 4 risorse: Trovi il cadavere di qualcuno che un tempo conoscevi e ti rammarichi di non averlo potuto salvare. Alla fine del round, scegli un altro investigatore di un qualsiasi gruppo. Quell'investigatore ottiene 4 risorse. (Limite di una volta in totale per partita.)
flavor: Questa sezione del complesso è piena di cadaveri smagriti: alcune sono creature naturali, altre mai viste prima.
back_flavor: Questo strano complesso industriale è composto da lunghi corridoi di acciaio corrugato e di cemento. Le molte porte chiuse a chiave e i vicoli ciechi fanno temere che non sarà facile trovare la via d'uscita.
real_text: [fast] Spend 4 resources: You find the corpse of someone you think you once knew, and wish you could have saved them. At the end of the round, choose another investigator in any group. That investigator gains 4 resources. (Group limit once per game.)

name: Corridoio Labirintico
text: [action] [action]: Sbirciando oltre uno specchio gigantesco, noti un riflesso insolito. Alla fine del round, scegli un altro investigatore di un qualsiasi gruppo. Quell'investigatore può effettuare 2 azioni aggiuntive durante il suo turno successivo. (Limite di una volta in totale per partita.)
flavor: Le pareti e i pavimenti di questi corridoi sono ricoperti di muschio, muffa e rampicanti.
back_flavor: Questo strano complesso industriale è composto da lunghi corridoi di acciaio corrugato e di cemento. Le molte porte chiuse a chiave e i vicoli ciechi fanno temere che non sarà facile trovare la via d'uscita.
real_text: [action] [action]: You peer through an overgrown mirror and see an unfamiliar reflection. At the end of the round, choose another investigator in any group. That investigator may take 2 additional actions during his or her next turn. (Group limit once per game.)

name: Camera della Fame
text: [fast] Se non ci sono indizi sulla Camera della Fame: Qualcuno ha tracciato degli strani segni sul vetro. Prendi il controllo del Diagramma della Fame messo da parte.
flavor: Sembra lo zoo di un sadico.
back_flavor: Questo luogo ospita un serraglio di creature: alcune naturali, altre orrende e deformi. Un mostro si scaglia contro il vetro della sua gabbia non appena la porta si apre.
real_text: [fast] If there are no clues on Chamber of Hunger: There is something strange drawn on the glass. Take control of the set-aside Hunger Diagram.

name: Camera della Decomposizione
text: [fast] Se non ci sono indizi sulla Camera della Decomposizione: Trovi un diario con alcune strane scritte scarabocchiate in fretta. Prendi il controllo del Diagramma della Decomposizione messo da parte.
flavor: L'aria è umida e pesante. Gli occhi bruciano ed è impossibile smettere di tossire.
back_flavor: Questa stanza è occupata da lunghe file di piante di diverse forme e tipologie, in varie fasi di crescita e di decomposizione. Al centro c'è un pannello di controllo pieno di leve e manopole misteriose.
real_text: [fast] If there are no clues on Chamber of Decay: There's a journal here with some strange scribblings. Take control of the set-aside Decay Diagram.

name: Camera della Putrefazione
text: [fast] Se non ci sono indizi sulla Camera della Putrefazione: Qualcuno ha inciso delle strane scritte sulle pareti. Prendi il controllo del Diagramma della Putrefazione messo da parte.
flavor: Una botola nel pavimento conduce a una camera separata.
back_flavor: Questa camera è piena di interiora, muco e resti umani. Il fetore acre e putrefatto che aleggia nell'aria irrita le narici.
real_text: [fast] If there are no clues on Chamber of Rot: There is something strange etched on the walls. Take control of the set-aside Rot Diagram.

name: Camera del Veleno
text: [action]: Attraversi la fossa di sostanze tossiche e giri la valvola sul lato opposto (attivare questa capacità senza l'antidoto potrebbe essere letale).
back_text: La scala a pioli che conduce alla Camera del Veleno deve essere abbassata. Come costo aggiuntivo per farti entrare nella Camera del Veleno, gli investigatori nella Camera della Putrefazione devono spendere un totale di 1 [per_investigator] indizi.
flavor: La poltiglia verde e giallastra ribolle e si agita minacciosamente. Oltre la fossa, si trova un pannello di controllo dotato di una singola valvola di rame.
back_flavor: Una scala a pioli sospesa scende fino a metà della parete di una stanza di cemento, piena di una poltiglia gorgogliante che emana un orrendo fetore.
real_text: [action]: You cross the noxious pit and turn the valve at the end. (Beware - activating this ability without the antidote may be deadly.)

name: Magazzino Abbandonato
flavor: Pesanti porte blindate e saldamente sigillate conducono al magazzino abbandonato. Dall'altro lato provengono delle voci che sembrano echeggiare tutt'intorno alla stanza, come se provenissero da più dimensioni.
back_flavor: Non c'è alcuna via di uscita.

name: Rune Arcane
text: Rivelazione - Assegna le Rune Arcane a un luogo [[Distorsione]]. [fast] Se ci sono 1 [per_investigator] risorse su questa carta: Girala e segui le istruzioni riportate sull'altro lato. [action]: tafuEtfe aun vorap id[intellect])3(. eS iha cseocu,ss lalcooc 1 asisorr us seqaut ra.act Se un investigatore di questo gruppo è riuscito a risolvere la capacità soprastante, questa carta ottiene: "[action]: atfefuEt nau arpvo id [intellect] 3).( oNn oupi tevirsien tacre ni tesuqa vorap id t.labàii eS iha cseocu,ss oaccllo 1 assiorr lluas icapo id euRn ecAanr id nu rloat purp.og"
back_text:
Se fai parte del gruppo A:
Le rune si illuminano e una parte della parete scorre via per rivelare un compartimento segreto, pieno di oggetti assortiti.
Metti in gioco la Chiave dei Misteri nella Camera dei Segreti. Gira questa carta.
Se fai parte del gruppo B:
Sul vetro della cisterna, che si sta lentamente riempiendo d'acqua, noti uno schema che inizia a risplendere.
Gli investigatori di questo gruppo possono immediatamente scambiare indizi tra loro. Sposta un qualsiasi numero di indizi dalla Camera della Pioggia alla Camera del Dolore o viceversa. Gira questa carta.
Se fai parte del gruppo C:
Le rune di questa camera si muovono e compongono una parola.
La parola che vedi è la stessa parola scritta sulla parete della Camera dei Segreti nell'area di gioco del gruppo A (puoi esaminare l'area di gioco del gruppo A). Gira questa carta.
flavor: Noti nella camera una serie di rune arcane incise sulla parete. Se riesci a decifrarle e a disporle nell'ordine giusto, forse qualcosa cambierà...
real_text:
In your chamber, you see a set of arcane runes etched upon the wall. If you can decode them and set them in the correct order, perhaps it will change something...
Revelation - Attach Arcane Runes to a [[Distortion]] location. [fast] If there are 1 [per_investigator] resources on this card: Flip it over and follow the instructions on its other side. [action]: sTte[intellect])3(. fI uoy ucdee,cs ceapl 1 cesueorr no tsih cr.ad If an investigator in this group has successfully resolved the above ability, this card gains: "[action]: es)3T[intellect](t. oYu ancnto mctmio rdcsa ot htsi klisl e.tts fI uyo duec,esc ealcp 1 srcrouee no nhotera ugpro's coyp fo raeAnc nRues."

name: Il Varco
text: Rivelazione - Assegna Il Varco al capitolo attuale. Se sei al Capitolo 1, i gruppi B e C mettono in gioco la Chiave dei Misteri messa da parte in un luogo [[Distorsione]]. Obbligo - Alla fine del round, se ci sono 3 o più destini sulla trama di ogni gruppo: Lo squarcio si ingrandisce a sufficienza da consentire a un investigatore di attraversarlo. Scegliete un investigatore in un qualsiasi luogo che attraversi il varco. Poi quell'investigatore gira questa carta e segue le istruzioni riportate sull'altro lato.
back_text: Ogni investigatore che ha attraversato il varco prende questa carta storia e si incontra in privato, lontano da ogni gruppo. Gli investigatori all'interno del varco possono parlare liberamente e scambiarsi un qualsiasi numero di indizi, risorse, carte dalla mano o supporti storia che controllano. Una volta soddisfatti, gli investigatori tornano al loro gruppo originale. Gira questa carta.
flavor: Con un improvviso lampo di luce, un varco inizia ad aprirsi su una parete vicina: l'energia si stabilizza fino a formare un portale. È ancora troppo piccolo per poterlo varcare, ma presto sarà abbastanza grande da consentire a una persona di passare...
back_flavor: Ti ritrovi in una specie di fulcro, una sorta di crocevia dell'etere. Altri prigionieri si sono fatti strada fino a qui. Forse puoi collaborare con loro per trovare una via di fuga.
real_text:
With a sudden flash of light, a rift begins to open in the wall nearby, energy slowly coalescing into the shape of a portal. It is too small to enter now, but soon it will be large enough for a person to step through...
Revelation - Attach The Rift to the current act. If it is act 1, Groups B and C put the set-aside Key of Mysteries into play at a [[Distortion]] location. Forced - At the end of the round, if there is at least 3 doom on each group's agenda: The rift opens wide enough for an investigator to step through. Choose an investigator at any location to enter the rift. Then, that investigator flips this card over and follows the instructions on its other side.

name: Il Condotto
text: Rivelazione - Colloca Il Condotto in un luogo [[Distorsione]]. Se sei al Capitolo 1, i gruppi B e C mettono in gioco la Chiave dei Misteri messa da parte nella loro copia di quel luogo. [fast]: Colloca un qualsiasi numero di tuoi segnalini risorsa o indizio su questa carta e/o colloca un qualsiasi numero di supporti [[Oggetto]] che controlli sotto questa carta. Puoi anche collocare un appunto sotto questa carta. [action]: Prendi il controllo di un qualsiasi numero di segnalini, carte e/o appunti da/sotto questa carta. [reaction] Alla fine del round: Spedisci tutti i segnalini e le carte radunate qui lungo il condotto di ventilazione. Gira questa carta e segui le istruzioni sull'altro lato.
back_text: Prendi le carte, i segnalini e gli appunti da/sotto questa carta e collocali sopra/sotto la copia de Il Condotto di un altro gruppo. Gira questa carta.
flavor: Trovi un condotto di ventilazione dove puoi nascondere alcuni oggetti importanti...
back_flavor: Gli oggetti scivolano lungo il condotto, rimbalzando rumorosamente dietro le pareti e sotto il pavimento. Forse un altro gruppo riuscirà a trovarli...
real_text:
You find a ventilation shaft through which you can fit some important items...
Revelation - Place The Vent in a [[Distortion]] location. If it is act 1, Groups B and C put the set-aside Key of Mysteries into play at that location. [fast]: Place any number of your resource tokens or clues on this card, and/or place any number of [[Item]] assets you control underneath this card. You may also place a written note underneath this card. [action]: Take control of any number of tokens, cards, or notes on/underneath this card. [reaction] At the end of the round: You send all of the tokens and cards gathered here through the ventilation shaft. Flip this card over and follow the instructions on the other side.

name: Il Dilemma
text: Rivelazione - Metti in gioco Il Dilemma accanto al mazzo dei capitoli. Il capitolo attuale ottiene: "[reaction] Alla fine del round: Anche se disperato, sei disposto a sacrificarti per il bene degli altri gruppi. Gira questa carta e segui le istruzioni sull'altro lato."
back_text:
Scegli e scarta tutte le carte dalla tua mano tranne X carte e rimuovi tutte le risorse dalla tua riserva delle risorse tranne X risorse, dove X è l'ammontare di destini sulla trama attuale.
Leggi il brano seguente a ogni gruppo a voce alta:
Le parole e le lettere sul biglietto cambiano e si spostano fino a formare uno strano diagramma.
L'investigatore capo del gruppo A prende il controllo del Diagramma della Putrefazione messo da parte. L'investigatore capo del gruppo B prende il controllo del Diagramma della Fame messo da parte. L'investigatore capo del gruppo C prende il controllo del Diagramma della Decomposizione messo da parte. Rimuovete dal gioco la copia de Il Dilemma di ogni gruppo.
flavor: Sul biglietto del tuo gruppo compaiono altre parole, come se un'entità invisibile le avesse appena scritte. Il messaggio recita: "Non preoccuparti. Offrirò ai tuoi amici un'opportunità di scappare. Non devi fare altro che perire in loro nome, e riceveranno un modo per fuggire. Devi solo scrivere 'scelgo la morte' su questo biglietto e il patto sarà stretto."
back_flavor: Scrivi "scelgo la morte" sul biglietto. Altre parole compaiono subito sotto le tue e vanno a formare una frase di risposta: "Pensi veramente che ti lascerei morire tanto facilmente?"
real_text:
Glowing words appear on your group's note as though written by an unseen entity. It reads: "Worry not. I shall give your friends a chance to escape. All you have to do is perish at their expense, and they will be given the means to escape. Just write 'I choose death' on this note here, and the deed will be done."
Revelation - Put The Dilemma into play, next to the act deck. The current act gains: "[reaction] At the end of the round: Desperate, you are willing to sacrifice yourself for the benefit of the other groups. Flip The Dilemma over and follow the instructions on the other side."

name: Il Portale
text: Rivelazione - Assegna Il Portale a un luogo [[Distorsione]]. [action] Spendi 1 indizio. Varchi la soglia. Gira questa carta e segui le istruzioni sull'altro lato.
back_text:
In base al gruppo a cui appartieni, metti in gioco un luogo diverso:
- Se fai parte del gruppo A, metti in gioco la Camera della Putrefazione.
- Se fai parte del gruppo B, metti in gioco la Camera della Fame.
- Se fai parte del gruppo C, metti in gioco la Camera della Decomposizione.
Disimpegnati da ogni nemico e muoviti fino al luogo appena messo in gioco.
Finché ci sono 4 o meno destini sulla trama attuale, quel luogo non è considerato collegato ad alcun altro luogo.
Rimuovi questa carta dal gioco.
flavor: All'interno della camera noti una porta che fino a un istante fa non c'era. La stanza sull'altro lato è immersa nel buio. Dove condurrà?
back_flavor: Non appena hai varcato la soglia, il portale scompare alle tue spalle. Dovrai cavartela da solo, almeno per il momento...
real_text:
You notice a doorway in your chamber that wasn't there before. On the other side, the hall is pitch black. Where does it lead?
Revelation - Attach The Gate to a [[Distortion]] location. [action] Spend 1 clue: You enter the doorway. Flip this story card over and follow the instructions on its other side.

[action]: Effettua una prova di [willpower] (4) per disporre i glifi nell'ordine giusto. Se hai successo, colloca 1 orrore sulla copia dei Glifi Criptati di ogni gruppo.
back_text:
Se fai parte del gruppo A: Un investigatore a vostra scelta prende il controllo del Diagramma della Putrefazione messo da parte. Rimuovete questa carta dal gioco.
Se fate parte del gruppo B: Un investigatore a vostra scelta prende il controllo del Diagramma della Fame messo da parte. Rimuovete questa carta dal gioco.
Se fai parte del gruppo C: Un investigatore a vostra scelta prende il controllo del Diagramma della Decomposizione messo da parte. Rimuovete questa carta dal gioco.
flavor: All'interno della camera noti tre righe di strani glifi incisi su una parete. Una riga sembra più luminosa delle altre.
back_flavor: Le rune all'interno di questa camera risplendono e uno strano messaggio compare sulla parete.

name: The Boundary, Broken
back_text:
Check Campaign Log. If the Harbinger is still alive:
Following no telltale flash of light, a sudden explosion of thunder blasts across the sky, causing you to jump in shock. As though drawn from the sound, a streak of silver lightning crashes down from the clouds, ripping a tear in the world before you. Through this tear, a familiar creature emerges. It hisses in anger and raises its gilded spear to attack.
Search the collection for the Harbinger of Valusia and spawn it at the location farthest from all investigators (if there are 6 or more tally marks under "Yig's Fury" in your Campaign Log, it enters play at the lead investigator's location, instead). It enters play with damage on it equal to the amount of damage recorded in parentheses in your Campaign Log.
flavor:
Ichtaca is already up and about when you awaken, donning her traditional armor, her bow on her back and a long blade at her side. "Something is wrong," she states cryptically. "I only meant to peer through the boundary…"
Her eyes are bloodshot, her face pale as a ghost. You suspect she hasn’t slept all night. "It matters not. It is time you witnessed the fate that will befall humanity if we fail."

name: The Barrier Is Thin
back_text:
Find each [[Tenochtitlán]] location in play with no clues on it. Add those locations to the victory display. Then, for each [[Present-Day]] location in play, search the exploration deck for a location with a matching location symbol in the upper-left corner and place it on top of that location, taking its place.
Each investigator loses each of his or her clues.
Spawn the set-aside Padma Amrita enemy in Templo Mayor.
Remove the current act deck from the game. Put the set-aside act 3a and agenda 3a into play as the current act and agenda.
flavor: Ichtaca’s strength continues to wane as you journey through the strange vision. You’ve never seen her this troubled. She is often distracted, peering about as though any moment the answer will appear before her. From time to time, she mutters strange phrases to herself: "…How could this have happened?…The answer will be with the ancients…Someone else is here, I know it…"
back_flavor: The silver flashes of lightning become more frequent, and the sky starts to split open. Thunder rumbles in the distance, and you watch as the skylines of both cities - the Present-Day city and its ancient predecessor - are consumed in a giant stone maw. Six pillars surround the cavernous opening, each glowing vibrantly. A red hue erupts from the center of the opening, and the ground shakes with the force of an earthquake. "We've seen enough. We must get out of here while we still can!" Ichtaca shouts. For the first time since meeting her, you hear a telltale trembling in her voice.

name: Time Collapsing
flavor: Alejandro’s former critic stands atop the steps of the main temple, her true self revealed to you. Silver streaks of lightning wind through her open arms. Coiled about her feet is an army of hissing cobras. "Only the chosen can find the Nexus! Only I am worthy!"
back_flavor: "Perhaps an eternity or two will quell your foolish desire to find the truth." Padma's laugh echoes across the sky as she steps through the rift atop the temple. "Not that it matters much. Your kind will not be on this Earth much longer…" She vanishes without a trace. You ask Ichtaca what your next course of action should be, but she too is gone. The storm suddenly quiets, and you are left in deafening silence.

name: Crossing the Threshold
text: Objective - After the first [[Tenochtitlán]] location enters play by exploring successfully, advance.
back_text: The investigator who just put a [[Tenochtitlán]] location into play by exploring successfully must test [willpower] (4). If he or she fails, he or she must search the collection for a random basic [[Madness]] or [[Injury]] weakness and shuffle it into his or her deck. (Note: Be aware that location connections are different on [[Tenochtitlán]] locations.)
flavor:
As you depart the hotel, you realize that the landscape of the city has been altered. Silver lightning crackles in the sky overhead, and the earth rumbles deep below your feet. Monstrous, polypous entities float just below the clouds. "What is going on?" you yell to Ichtaca over the whistling wind. "What is this place?"
"One future," she replies enigmatically.
back_flavor: In the distance, light seeps through a wide crack in the ground. As you approach it, you realize the chasm is not natural at all. Below, you see the sky, as if you were peering into a reflection of the clouds above. Wisps of grey smoke emerge from the chasm, giving off a familiar bittersweet scent. You step through and resist the urge to vomit as the world spins upside-down. When you open your eyes again, you are in another place. Not somewhere, but some<u>when</u>.

name: The Return Trip
text: Objective - If Padma Amrita is defeated, advance. Objective - If investigators in Templo Mayor spend the requisite number of clues, advance.
back_text:
If Padma Amrita was defeated:
"No! You fools!" Padma drops to her knees, bleeding out from her wounds. She looks up into Ichtaca's eyes, pleading with her. "How could you - ?" She is about to say something else when Ichtaca silences her with an arrow fired into her lung. "Go," says Ichtaca. "I'll be right behind you." You shake off your fear and step through the rift.
(→R1)
If the investigators spent clues to advance:
"No! Come back here!" Padma screams as soon as she figures out your plan. "You can't leave me here! I have been chosen!" Ichtaca looks back at her with a pitying glance. The two of them share a knowing look for a short moment, and you hear Padma cry, "How could you?" Ichtaca pays her no heed, turning back to face you. "Go. I'll be right behind you." You shake off your fear and step through the rift.
(→R1)
flavor: Ichtaca points to the temple in the distance, shouting over the raging storm. "It was her! She is the one trapping us here; she’s known all along!" One way or another, if you want to get back home, you’ll have to slip through the rift Padma entered from.
real_text: Objective - If Padma Amrita is defeated, advance. Objective - If investigators in Templo Mayor spend the requisite number of clues, advance.

name: The Jungle's Heart
text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.

Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
The lead investigator chooses one investigator to be the group's lookout. That investigator checks his or her supplies. 
If the lookout has binoculars, he or she is able to see the creature approaching and avoid it. The lookout suffers no ill effects.
If the lookout does not have binoculars, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until an enemy is discarded. Spawn that enemy at the lookout's location.
flavor: You are deep in the jungle now, surrounded on all sides by the uncharted wilderness. All around you, the rainforest sings, its lyrics found in every chirping insect, every serpent’s hiss, every snapping tree branch.
back_flavor: After exploring the rainforest for hours, you reach the top of a steep ridge, from which you can see much of the surrounding area. Uncanny winged creatures caw at you from above, circling over the cavern entrance like vultures waiting for their meal. From this vantage point, you may be able to see approaching threats as they traverse the brush below. If only you had something to help you see farther…
real_text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.

name: Setting Sun
text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.
back_text: Each surviving investigator immediately resigns.
flavor: The day advances quickly. Through the thick canopy of trees, you can tell that the sun is starting to sink closer to the horizon. To the east, the sky grows dim. Soon the jungle will be covered in darkness, and you will have to stop and make camp for the night.
back_flavor:
Night comes swiftly, blanketing the rainforest in dim moonlight. The sounds of the jungle change as nocturnal creatures start to emerge. Soon, the air is filled with the buzzing and chirping of strange insects and even stranger beasts, the identity of which you are unable to determine.
The dangers of nighttime are too great to ignore, and the darkness makes it difficult for you to study the glyphs and patterns necessary to shift the pillars correctly. You have no choice but to set up camp and continue your exploration in the morning.
real_text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.

name: Search for the Pattern
flavor: Six stone pillars surround the entrance to the cavern, each carved with a series of uncanny grooves and hieroglyphs that form an intricate pattern. Touching them causes the grooves to glow brightly, and twisting them causes the patterns to shift and change. Perhaps these patterns match the glyphs found in other regions of the jungle?

name: Opening the Maw
text: [action] Investigators at the Mouth of K'n-yan spend 1[per_investigator] clues, as a group: You solve one piece of the puzzle. Add 1 resource to the Mouth of K'n-yan, as a pillar token. Objective - Solve the puzzle of the six pillars in order to enter K'n-yan. If there are 6 pillar tokens on the Mouth of K'n-yan, advance to act 2b.
flavor: You have discovered that the ruins within the jungle each bear a distinct pattern of glyphs, which match those found on the six pillars. As you turn the pillars to match these patterns, a serpentine creature descends from the clouds…
back_flavor: With a deep rumbling that shakes the ground outside, something inside the cavern shifts. In a distinct sequence, the six obelisks slowly descend into the ground, twisting and turning. The serpent creature that guarded the cavern lets out a shriek of anger and hate before flying off and vanishing behind the treeline. One by one, the stone pillars disappear into the dirt, and the Earth stops shaking.
real_text: [action] Investigators at the Mouth of K'n-yan spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: You solve one piece of the puzzle. Add 1 resource to the Mouth of K'n-yan, as a pillar token. Check Campaign Log. If the Harbinger is still alive:
From the entrance far behind you, a threatening hiss and an all-too-familiar rattling causes you to freeze in terror. You grip the nearest weapon you can find and turn in fright, hands trembling. How has it followed you this far? When will this awful hunt end?
Search the collection for the Harbinger of Valusia and spawn it at the location farthest from all investigators (if there are 8 or more tally marks under "Yig's Fury" in your Campaign Log, it enters play at the lead investigator's location, instead). It enters play with damage on it equal to the amount of damage recorded in parentheses in your Campaign Log.
flavor: Though much of this cavern system is natural and untouched by humans, you are stunned to find signs of an ancient civilization that once inhabited the area.

flavor: Bright-yellow eyes peer at you from all sides as you continue delving deeper into the cavern. The glowing orbs vanish as light is cast on them, reappearing as soon as the darkness returns.
back_flavor: Without warning, a deafening crash echoes throughout the cave, and the ground under your feet rumbles with tremendous force. Stalactites and pieces of crumbling rock begin to fall from the ceiling of the cavern, striking the ground all around you and causing cracks to appear in the stone. "We have to get out of here!" you shout to Ichtaca, but by the time you realize what is coming, it is too late. The ground beneath your feet gives way, and suddenly you are falling, plummeting into the depths below…

text: Investigators cannot put [[Item]] assets into play (including [[Item]] weaknesses).

flavor: Somehow you have awoken in a futuristic city, inhabited by odd alien creatures beyond your imagining. You must explore this strange place if you are to find a way out, but your new body is difficult to get used to.
back_flavor: As you traverse these strange halls, you come across a chamber you hadn't noticed before. It is filled with trinkets and items of all kinds from various civilizations. Many of them match the descriptions you have given to the city's inhabitants - descriptions of the equipment you had on your person when you first encountered the creatures. Have they somehow replicated the objects you had with you? You take what you can find and continue exploring.

name: Lost Memories
text: Each investigator's maximum hand size is reduced by 2.
back_text:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. If The Custodian is in play and not controlled by an investigator, move it to the location with the most clues on it.
Check your supplies. If an investigator has a pendant, that investigator reads the following:
As you spend more and more time in the alien city, your memories of the past continue to fade. Then, a spark of hope returns to you, and you recall an object you once carried with you, one that brought you comfort when times were tough. You sift through the objects the Yithians replicated from your descriptions, and there you find it: a pendant on a silver chain. As you hold it, your real identity comes flooding back.
Each investigator with a pendant draws 2 cards. For the remainder of the scenario, each investigator with a pendant ignores any effect that would reduce his or her maximum hand size.
flavor: Little by little, the memories of your former life are starting to fade. The most recent events are the first to disappear, but soon you begin to lose your grip on your human identity.
real_text: Each investigator's maximum hand size is reduced by 2.

name: Humanity Fading
text: Each investigator's maximum hand size is reduced by 4.
back_text: Each surviving investigator is defeated.
flavor:
How long has it been? Days? Weeks?

…Years?
back_flavor: You forget all that you once were. Your name, and your humanity, are lost. However, the lost city of Pnakotus calls to you, its peaceful halls a treasure trove of knowledge more vast than anything your mind could have comprehended before your arrival here. Your purpose lost in the haze, you live out your days with the Great Race of Yith, until one day...
real_text: Each investigator's maximum hand size is reduced by 4.

name: Exploring Pnakotus
text: Each copy of Yithian Observer gains aloof.
back_text: Put each set-aside location into play (Great Library, Laboratory of the Great Race, Yithian Orrery, Deconstuction Room, and Towers of Pnakotus). Choose one of those locations at random. Put the set-aside The Custodian asset into play at the randomly chosen location. (Note: Each copy of Yithian Observer is no longer aloof.)
flavor: Getting out of this strange city might be harder than you thought. Its halls are endless and filled with all manner of complex, futuristic machinery.
back_flavor: You explore the area near your interview chamber for some time, learning more of this city and its dwellers. It is a place of knowledge and research, inhabited by beings who call themselves the Great Race of Yith. For the most part, the Yithians allow you to explore the city without troubling you, though some of them follow you about and observe you with keen interest. As you pass through one of the city's meandering halls, you find a panel attached to the wall. It is a technological device you cannot hope to understand. As you stand in front of it, dumbfounded, one of your observers approaches cautiously. It extends one of its claw-appendages and manipulates the panel in a convoluted manner. To your surprise, the wall in front of you slides open to reveal another series of halls. The creature steps aside to let you pass.
real_text: Each copy of Yithian Observer gains aloof.

Place this act in the victory display with this side faceup, as a reminder.< - An investigator "found the process." - An investigator "dissected an organ." - An investigator "interviewed a subject." - An investigator "realized what year it is." - An investigator "activated the device." - An investigator controls The Custodian.
flavor: You have to find a way back home. Surely if the Yithians can bring you to this place, there must be a way to return…
back_flavor: You believe you have discovered the process used by the Yithians to transport you here. But the truth is hard to accept. Your body was never brought to this place. Your mind has been transferred into the body of one of these creatures. Somewhere, in another place - in another time - one of the reviled creatures dwells in your body.

text: Each Yithian Observer gains hunter. [action] Spend 1 clue: Draw. Draw 2 cards instead of 1. If your hand exceeds your maximum hand size, draw 1 additional card. flavor: You have gathered the knowledge necessary to repossess your body, but before you can initiate the process, you must expand your mind.
back_flavor:
The machine whirs with intense vibration. It has taken many hours to construct, and you have had to build it in secret, using the knowledge you have gathered from the various areas within the city. It is a strange device of rods, wheels, and glass, about the size of a small filing cabinet. A circular mirror in the center sends your alien reflection staring back at you.
You activate the device, and you feel a tugging on your psyche, stretching your consciousness across the aether of space and time. The memories come flooding back.

text:
Each of your [[Ally]] assets gains the [[Yithian]] trait.
[reaction] After you commit a card to a skill test you are performing: Double the skill icons on that card. (Limit once per test.)
[elder_sign] effect: +2. Draw 1 card.
back_text: Deck Size: What it used to be, when you were human. Deckbuilding Options: Yithians can't build decks. Deckbuilding Requirements: (do not count toward deck size): Do you remember...?
back_flavor: And then the morbid temptation to look down at myself became greater and greater, till one night I could not resist it. At first my downward glance revealed nothing whatsoever. A moment later I perceived that this was because my head lay at the end of a flexible neck of enormous length. Retracting this neck and gazing down very sharply, I saw the scale, rugose, iridescent bulk of a vast cone ten feet tall and ten feet wide at the base. THat was when I waked half of Arkham with my screaming as I plunged madly up from the abyss of sleep. - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Shadow out of Time</u>

name: The Descent Begins
back_text: Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it in the location where the investigators began at this depth level.
flavor: Slowly and cautiously, you begin your descent into the red-litten caverns of Yoth. It is quiet, and only the crumbling of stone and your echoing footfalls can be heard in the tunnels surrounding you.
back_flavor: The serpents' ruins are ancient, decrepit, and devoid of life. Nearly all of their structures have collapsed, but evidence of their great cities remains, along with statues and idols of their gods. This realm must have been abandoned long ago.

name: Horrific Descent
back_text: Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it at the location where the investigators began at this depth level. Check your supplies. If an investigator has a canteen, that investigator must decide: - This could be useful. Remember that you have "collected a strange liquid." - I'm not going anywhere near that.You suffer no ill effects.
flavor: Hisses begin to emanate from the tunnels all around you. Snake eyes glare at you from the dark as you attempt to avoid encountering the creatures that remain in this realm. You weave in and out of narrow tunnels and hide behind broken‑down walls and crumbling pillars.
back_flavor: You pass through a cracked earthen clearing that once might have been a plaza. Standing half-collapsed in the center of the plaza are the remains of a stone fountain, dry as a bone. At the very bottom of the fountain's basin is a glob of black syrupy ooze.

name: Endless Caverns
back_text:
Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it at the location where the investigators began at this depth level.
The lead investigator chooses one investigator to be the group's scout. That investigator checks his or her supplies.
If the scout has rope, he or she is able to climb up with ease, and the investigators suffer no ill effects. 
If the scout does not have rope, he or she must test [combat] or [agility] (5). If the performing investigator fails, he or she makes it to the top but suffers 1 physical trauma from the exhaustion of the climb.
flavor: You are convinced of it now: these caverns are without end. They must span the entirety of the subterranean layer of the Earth. Will you ever reach the Nexus? Will you ever make it home?
back_flavor: The path ahead is blocked by a sheer rock cliff. You start to search for a way around when suddenly, hisses and shrieks emerge from behind you, and the area is bathed in orange fire-light. The serpents are coming - one of you must climb to safety and pull the others up!

name: City of Blood
back_text:
If the Harbinger of Valusia is set aside, move it to the pursuit area.
Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it at the location where the investigators began at this depth level.
flavor: The caverns are no longer quiet. The angry cries and rattling of serpent creatures is all around you now, urging you onward. The cavern’s unnatural red glow becomes more intense. In this red light, the cities of Yoth take on another guise - no longer a source of hidden knowledge, but a place of animosity that resents your mere presence.
back_flavor: The shrill noise of hundreds of snake rattles suddenly erupts throughout the cavern. You have crossed into territory that humanity was never meant to enter. The earsplitting alarm pierces your eardrums and causes your ears to bleed. Your senses are overwhelmed, and you cover your ears in vain. You cannot hear your own thoughts. Finally the warning ends, and you are left with the uncontrollable urge to flee. However, you know that if you fled now, your actions would endanger all of humanity. Bravely - or perhaps foolishly - you press onward.

name: Fury That Shakes the Earth
text: Forced - After the third doom is placed on this agenda: Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it at the location where the investigators began at this depth level.
back_text:
Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it at the location where the investigators began at this depth level.
If Yig is set aside:
The ground shakes with each of the massive creature's steps. He crushes the stone beneath his mighty feet, tearing through walls with his clawed, scaly hands. He sets his hateful eyes on you, unhinging his jaw in a cruel display of hunger.
Spawn Yig in the location where the investigators began at this depth level.
flavor: The serpents have stirred up something much larger and more deadly than anything you have faced on this journey. Pale, sweaty, and terrified, you scurry for an exit - any exit.
real_text: Forced - After the third doom is placed on this agenda: Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it at the location where the investigators began at this depth level.

name: The Red Depths
text: Forced - After any amount of doom is placed on this agenda: Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it at the location where the investigators began at this depth level.
back_text: Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it in the location where the investigators began at this depth level. Until the end of the scenario, the current agenda gains: "Forced - After any amount of doom is placed on the current agenda: Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it in the location where the investigators began at this depth level." Place this card in the pursuit area with this side faceup, as a reminder.
flavor: The deeper your descent, the brighter and more pervasive the red glow of the caverns becomes. If you didn’t know any better, you would think you were descending into the very depths of hell itself.
back_flavor: Nothing can stop the denizens of Yoth. They emerge from hidden places all around you, hissing their foul curses. The caves are plunged into chaos as the serpents close in.
real_text: Forced - After any amount of doom is placed on this agenda: Find the enemy that is in pursuit with the highest evade value, and spawn it at the location where the investigators began at this depth level.

name: VENGEANCE
text: Forced - At the end of the 'check doom threshold' step of the mythos phase: The investigators must draw 1 additional encounter card for each doom in play, in player order. Objective - If each investigator is defeated, advance this agenda.
flavor: You never should have come here.
back_flavor: The serpents chase you relentlessly through the tunnels and ruined cities of Yoth, giving you no quarter, no rest, no chance of escape. You cannot hope to hide from their uncanny senses, nor can you run for much longer. Desperate for any way to elude them - any way at all - you run to a nearby chasm. A lone narrow bridge spans the pit. Underneath is a bottomless black abyss that devours the red light of Yoth.
real_text: Forced - At the end of the 'check doom threshold' step of the mythos phase: The investigators must draw 1 additional encounter card for each doom in play, in player order. Objective - If each investigator is defeated, advance this agenda.

name: Journey to the Nexus
text: [action] If there are no clues on your location: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it. Objective - At the end of the round, if investigators at Steps of Yoth possess the requisite number of clues, they may advance. (Beware - any investigator who is not at Steps of Yoth will be defeated.)
back_text: Add 1 resource to the current depth level. If the current depth level is 5+ and you are playing in Campaign Mode, go to (→R2). Otherwise, perform the following: - Each investigator who is not at Steps of Yoth is left behind and is defeated. Each surviving investigator loses each of his or her clues. - Move each enemy in play to the pursuit area. - Remove all doom from locations in play. Set each location in play and in the exploration deck aside, out of play. Investigators are not defeated during this process. - Draw a random set-aside location other than Steps of Yoth, put it into play, and place each surviving investigator at that location. - Create a new exploration deck consisting of Steps of Yoth and 4 other random set-aside locations. Shuffle the exploration deck. - Flip this act back over. Journey as deep as you can…
flavor: Doubt and horror grew upon me as I wound still farther down the seemingly endless staircase. Would the thing never stop?– H. P. Lovecraft and Zealia Bishop, <u>The Mound</u>

flavor: A twisting passage over the chasm leads to a set of narrow, steep steps bathed in the red glow of the depths farther below.

The thing emerges from the lightless void beyond the Nexus. It is a being of black polymorphic ichor, an animated viscous ooze that crawls along the ground with shapeless limbs and leaves a trail of smooth, dissolved stone in its wake.

The timeline collapses.
Reality dissolves before your very eyes. First to vanish is the environment around you: the matter blurs and thins into strings of light that fade into an empty void.
Next comes your body: it disintegrates slowly and painlessly into hundreds of millions of subatomic particles, which diffuse throughout the vast emptiness.
Finally, your cognition: your memories of events both real and unreal. Your hopes and dreams. Thoughts that never held any significance in the infinite scheme of the cosmos.

text: Objective - If an investigator enters A Pocket in Time, advance.
back_text: Shuffle the set-aside [[Shattered]] locations into the exploration deck. Each investigator shuffles the topmost [[Hex]] treachery in the encounter discard pile into the exploration deck. Advance to Act 3a - "The Yithian Relic." - If the investigators found the missing relic, advance to Act 3a - "The Yithian Relic."
flavor: Somewhere deep within this nexus of worlds lies your objective: a place where timelines converge. You can see it in flashes of insight from beyond this reality. Windows into other timelines. A place carved out of time and space, where the Brotherhood no doubt resides.
back_flavor: What you see before you is truly staggering. Throughout these halls are hundreds of windows into places both ancient and futuristic: once-grand civilizations that came before even the earliest records of known history, and more still that have yet to be realized. The psychological weight of this discovery is almost more than your mind can bear. Humans are not the masters or caretakers of the Earth. They are merely a footnote in a much longer history - a history which is about to be revised.

Ichtaca observes you with narrow yellow eyes as you manipulate the thrumming device in your hands. Power seeps from the device's every aperture. Rays of blinding light shoot forth from the cracks appearing on its surface. flavor: Despite everything that has occurred since you were last here, the Eztli temple remains the same as it was when you first explored it, preserved in an echo of time. You use your memories to guide you, heading deeper into the ruins once more.
back_flavor: You pass by carvings in the walls and hieroglyphs etched into stone altars. The location of the relic's vault is already locked deep in your memory.
real_text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.

name: The Chamber of Still Remains
text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it. Objective - Only investigators in the Chamber of Time may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
back_text: Choose an investigator in the Chamber of Time to take control of the Relic of Ages. Search the collection for Yig (The Forgotten Age card #296). Spawn it in the Chamber of Time. Place this act in the victory display. It gains Vengeance 2.
flavor: In the central chamber deep within the core of the ruins, the relic awaits.
back_flavor: The relic hums with power and throbs in your hands. Energy from the device seeps into the corridors of the ruins, and the structure of the temple shifts. However, this does not matter to you. Escaping with the relic is no longer your goal. You skillfully work the hidden components of the device once more, manipulating the very fabric of time in the environment around you. Determined to stop all of this from having ever occurred, you turn the clock back once more.
real_text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it. Objective - Only investigators in the Chamber of Time may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

flavor: You stand in the center of the relic’s vault, surrounded on all sides by slain Eztli warriors. The Father of Serpents stands before you, his hiss shaking you to your bones. This is where the Eztli made their last stand. Now, only you stand in the creature’s way.
back_flavor: The creature roars in pain. His tail thrashes violently, crushing several pillars and sending you flying to the ground. He retreats with a hateful, rumbling hiss. You turn your attention back to the relic and the chamber that was built to preserve it. It is time to end this, once and for all. It is time to do what must be done.
real_text: Relic of Ages gains: "[action]: Test [willpower] or [intellect] (4). If you succeed, flip a clue controlled by an investigator at your location to its doom side, and place it on your location. Then, deal 3 damage to Yig." Objective - If Yig is defeated, advance.
